login.title: Sign in to Kubu
login.description:
Sign in with the email and password you use in the Kubu app.

Home Assistant adds every Kubu sensor in your account that it can hear, and adds the others as soon as they are in range. Sensors are read locally over Bluetooth.

Your password is not saved. The Kubu cloud is only needed now, to get each sensor's key. After that, Home Assistant keeps a sign-in token, like the Kubu app does, to check your account daily and when it hears a new Kubu sensor. This is optional: turn on offline mode to stop it.

Sensors must already be set up in the Kubu app.

data_description.offline_mode: After setup, never contact the Kubu cloud on its own. Sensors are read over Bluetooth only. New sensors and changes in the Kubu app are not picked up until you sign in again or add a sensor by hand.

unverified.title: Untested sensors
unverified.description:
These sensors are of models that have not been tested with this integration yet:

{sensors}

They are read the same way the Kubu app reads them, so they should work, but some states may be wrong or missing. Please tell us how it goes, good or bad: open an issue at {issues_url} with the sensor's diagnostics file (*device page → ⋮ → Download diagnostics*) and what you did (locked, opened, tilted…).

Set them up anyway?

sign_in.title: Sign in to Kubu
sign_in.description:
Kubu BLE now sets up one entry per Kubu account, with your sensors in it. {count} sensor(s) still use the old setup, which can't pick up changes made in the Kubu app.

Sign in once to move them. Devices, entity IDs, names and history stay the same. Your password is not saved.

not_in_account.description: {name} is no longer in your Kubu account. It still works with its saved key. If you removed it from the Kubu app on purpose, remove it here too: open the Kubu BLE entry and delete the sensor.
